name: Todoist
desc: Cross-platform task manager with labels, filters, natural-language dates and recurring tasks.
fit: Create a label for your 1·3·5 items and a 'today' filter that shows only those nine.

name: TickTick
desc: To-do lists with a built-in focus timer, habit tracker and calendar view.
fit: Use the built-in focus timer for your two daily sprints.

name: Microsoft To Do
desc: Free list app with a 'My Day' view that resets every morning.
fit: 'My Day' maps neatly onto a nine-item 13522 day.

name: Things
desc: Design-focused task manager for Apple devices with Today and Evening sections.
fit: Put your Big + Medium in Today and the 5 small tasks in This Evening.

name: Notion
desc: Docs, databases and wikis in one workspace; widely used for planning templates.
fit: Build a database with a 'Tier' select (Big/Medium/Small) and a daily view.

name: Trello
desc: Kanban boards with cards, checklists and automation rules.
fit: Three columns — Big, Medium, Small — capped with list limits of 1, 3 and 5.

name: Asana
desc: Team work management with projects, timelines, goals and workload views.
fit: Use 'My Tasks' sections for tiers so each teammate runs a 13522 day.

name: ClickUp
desc: All-in-one project tool with tasks, docs, goals, whiteboards and time tracking.
fit: Custom priority field for tiers; time estimates feed the capacity check.

name: Motion
desc: AI calendar that auto-schedules tasks around meetings and deadlines.
fit: Let it place your Big task in your best focus window automatically.

name: Reclaim.ai
desc: Smart calendar assistant that defends focus time, habits and breaks.
fit: Create two recurring 'Focus Sprint' habits to protect your sprints.

name: Sunsama
desc: Guided daily planning ritual that pulls tasks from your other tools.
fit: Its morning planning and evening shutdown mirror the two 13522 reviews.

name: Akiflow
desc: Inbox that consolidates tasks from many apps for time-blocking.
fit: Collect everything, then drag only nine items into today.

name: ChatGPT
desc: General AI assistant for drafting, summarising and brainstorming.
fit: Paste your brain dump and ask it to size each item into Big, Medium or Small.

name: Claude
desc: AI assistant for writing, analysis and long documents.
fit: Ask it to turn your Big task into a 90-minute step-by-step plan.

name: Gemini
desc: Google's AI assistant, integrated with Workspace apps.
fit: Summarise long email threads so small tasks stay small.

name: Microsoft Copilot
desc: AI assistant across Windows and Microsoft 365.
fit: Draft meeting recaps to shrink admin into the 5 small slots.

name: Otter.ai
desc: Real-time meeting transcription and summaries.
fit: Turn meeting action items straight into tomorrow's small tasks.

name: Fathom
desc: AI note-taker for video calls with highlights and summaries.
fit: Skip manual notes and keep meetings out of your Big slot.

name: Obsidian
desc: Local-first markdown notes with links and plugins.
fit: Keep a daily note template with 1·3·5 headings and two review prompts.

name: Toggl Track
desc: Simple one-click time tracking with reports.
fit: Measure how long your 'medium' tasks really take, then recalibrate.

name: Clockify
desc: Free time tracker and timesheet app for teams.
fit: Tag entries by tier to see where your day actually goes.

name: RescueTime
desc: Automatic time tracking with focus sessions and distraction blocking.
fit: Compare focus time on days you hit 13522 vs days you don't.

name: Forest
desc: Gamified focus timer that grows a virtual tree while you stay off your phone.
fit: One tree per sprint makes the two-sprint goal visible.

name: Freedom
desc: Blocks distracting sites and apps across devices on a schedule.
fit: Schedule blocks to match your sprint windows.

name: Focusmate
desc: Virtual co-working sessions with an accountability partner.
fit: Book your Big task as a 50-minute Focusmate session.

name: Brain.fm
desc: Functional music designed for focus, relaxation and sleep.
fit: Pair a focus track with each sprint.

name: Grammarly
desc: Writing assistant for grammar, clarity and tone.
fit: Speeds up small writing tasks so they stay under 15 minutes.

name: Zapier
desc: No-code automation connecting thousands of apps.
fit: Automate recurring small tasks so they leave your list for good.

name: Make
desc: Visual automation platform for multi-step workflows.
fit: Route form leads, invoices and reminders without manual steps.

name: Calendly
desc: Scheduling links that remove back-and-forth emails.
fit: Removes the 'find a time' small tasks entirely.
